lookup_spawn_object_id: look up the Minecraft mob spawn ID for a given mob name using SPAWN_OBJECTS
lookup_shape_function: look up the shapes module function for a canonicalized shape name using SPECIAL_SHAPE_FNS
canonicalize_shape_name: canonicalize a natural language shape name to its canonical form using SPECIAL_SHAPES_CANONICALIZE
review_spawn_objects_mapping: review the SPAWN_OBJECTS dictionary mapping Minecraft mob names to their numeric spawn IDs
review_shape_canonicalization: review the SPECIAL_SHAPES_CANONICALIZE dictionary mapping natural language shape names to canonical forms
